paper_title: Towards Predicting Any Human Trajectory In Context
caption: Performance of random example selection and the proposed STES at varying numbers of in-context examples.
model_annotation: This line chart compares the performance of two methods, TrajICL (blue line with circular markers) and Full FT (orange line with circular markers), measured by minFDE₂₀ (in units of meters, y-axis) across varying percentages of an in-context example pool (x-axis ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, labeled as “Percentage of In-Context Example Pool”). The x-axis uses a linear scale with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis uses a linear scale ranging from 22 to 28, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The blue TrajICL line starts at approximately 23.2 when the percentage is 0.0, decreases to about 22.4 at 0.2, then remains relatively flat until 0.6 before declining slightly to approximately 21.9 at 1.0. The orange Full FT line starts at approximately 29.0 when the percentage is 0.0, decreases to about 27.3 at 0.2, then remains relatively flat until 0.6 before declining to approximately 25.8 at 1.0.
